;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Attica wildfires]]
**[[Wildfire]]s in east and west [[Attica (region)|Attica]], [[Greece]], kill at least 76 people, leave another 172 injured, and burn hundreds of houses and vehicles, prompting a [[state of emergency]]. The Greek government requests help from [[European Union]] countries. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-greece-wildfire/greeks-flee-wildfire-raging-west-of-athens-idUSKBN1KD1F9 (Reuters)] [https://news.sky.com/story/state-of-emergency-in-greece-as-wildfires-force-people-to-flee-homes-11446677 (Sky News)]
*[[Attapeu dam collapse|2018 Laos dam collapse]]
**Heavy rains cause the Xepian-Xe Nam Noy hydropower dam in southern [[Laos]] to collapse, releasing a reported five billion cubic metres of water. As a result, 20 people are confirmed dead, over a hundred are missing, and 6,600 have been displaced. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-44935495 (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jul/24/laos-dam-collapse-hundreds-missing (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**Geologists monitoring the eruption of [[Kīlauea]] warned it could continue to spout [[lava]] for a long time. [https://www.wral.com/geologists-say-the-hawaii-volcano-eruption-could-last-for-months-or-even-years/17715609/ (WRAL)]
*The death toll from an intense heat wave in [[Japan]] rises to 77. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/japanese-city-sizzles-at-highest-recorded-temperature-of-411-degree-celsius (''The Straits Times'')]

;International relations
*[[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]]
**Photos taken on July 20 and 22 and published by [[38 North]] appear to show [[North Korea]] dismantling a ballistic missile launchpad and engine testing stand at the [[Sohae Satellite Launching Station]]. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/07/23/North-Korea-removes-key-facilities-at-missile-launching-station/7961532396147/ (UPI)]

;Law and crime
*[[2018 Toronto shooting]]
**Police identify the gunman in a deadly [[mass shooting]] in [[Toronto]], [[Canada]]. Investigators are still determining a motive. His family claims he had severe mental health problems. [https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.4757566 (CBC)]
*[[Femen]] co-founder and activist [[Oksana Shachko]] is found dead in her [[Paris]] apartment in an apparent suicide. [[France]] granted her political refugee status in 2013. [https://www.rferl.org/a/femen-activist-shachko-found-dead-in-paris-suicide-suspected/29386587.html (RFE/RL)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Protests against Rodrigo Duterte]]
**[[Timeline of protests against Rodrigo Duterte|Protesters]] take to the streets around [[Manila]] as [[President of the Philippines|Philippine President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] prepares for his [[State of the Nation Address (Philippines)|State of the Nation Address]] (SONA). [http://time.com/5345552/duterte-philippines-sexism-sona-women/ (''Time'')]
*[[17th Congress of the Philippines]]
**Majority of the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] elects [[President of the Philippines|Former President]] and current House Representative, [[Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo]] as House Speaker of the lower congress replacing [[Pantaleon Alvarez]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-duterte-congress/duterte-ally-and-ex-philippine-president-arroyo-gets-house-speaker-job-idUSKBN1KD1RH (Reuters)]
